threshold_note: Proposed practical effect sizes and observation floors, not power calculations or industry benchmarks. Finalize in preregistration before testing.

hypotheses.title: Show shared dancing immediately
hypotheses.hypothesis: A parent and child performing the first simple move during the opening improves 30-second retention compared with an otherwise comparable scene-setting opening.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: +5 percentage points median across three matched pairs
hypotheses.guardrails: APV decline no more than 3 points; no quality/cost breach
hypotheses.limitations: Keep music source unchanged; code first visible shared move; song and audience differences remain confounders.

hypotheses.title: Make cue and movement easy to follow
hypotheses.hypothesis: A stable full-body demonstration through each action improves APV compared with more camera changes, while adults report fewer confusing moments.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: +5 percentage points median across three matched pairs
hypotheses.guardrails: No loss of character quality; no safety/rights failure
hypotheses.limitations: Adult comprehension is separate qualitative evidence, not a combined score. Compare similar lengths.

hypotheses.title: Show the family pair in packaging
hypotheses.hypothesis: A parent and child visibly doing the same move communicates the activity more clearly than an adult-only cover.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: +1 percentage point median within comparable traffic cohorts across three matched pairs
hypotheses.guardrails: APV decline no more than 3 points; accurate promise
hypotheses.limitations: No native A/B test on Made for Kids. Adult concept comparison first; upload comparisons remain observational. At least 1000 impressions/video as a workflow floor.

hypotheses.title: Use parent-child turn-taking
hypotheses.hypothesis: A child-leads/adult-copies segment increases voluntary repeat interest while preserving song engagement.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: +5 percentage points median across three matched pairs
hypotheses.limitations: Use 3–5 or 6–7 cohorts separately; repeat intention is not actual repeat use.

hypotheses.title: Align words and visible actions
hypotheses.hypothesis: Matching the action verb to a clear demonstration reduces drops around instruction transitions.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: +5 percentage points median across three matched pairs
hypotheses.limitations: Always fix actual wrong/confusing cues as defects; never deliberately publish misleading control material.

hypotheses.title: Build occasion-based series
hypotheses.hypothesis: A recognizable family activity series generates more return behavior than unrelated song positioning.
hypotheses.variable: Series naming and coherent use occasion
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: Set only after a usable channel baseline; no threshold yet
hypotheses.guardrails: Production capacity; meaningful differences between songs
hypotheses.limitations: Deferred. Channel-level temporal comparison is highly confounded and cannot isolate the series effect.

hypotheses.title: Offer distinct activity levels
hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating simple copy-play and older two-step songs reduces confusion compared with one undifferentiated activity level.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: Set after baseline within each band; no cross-age winner claim
hypotheses.limitations: Deferred. This is segmentation research; ages in account analytics do not identify the child watching.

hypotheses.title: Try a purposeful compilation
hypotheses.hypothesis: A curated family dance session solves a longer activity occasion without hurting satisfaction.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: Set after several accepted songs; compare compilations with compilations
hypotheses.guardrails: No padding or low-value duplication; natural stopping points
hypotheses.limitations: Deferred. Do not compare APV directly with short single-song videos.

hypotheses.title: Test Shorts as a separate discovery format
hypotheses.hypothesis: A self-contained family dance excerpt attracts engaged Shorts viewing and some observable follow-on interest.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: Set after Shorts baseline; no threshold yet
hypotheses.guardrails: Original-song production cadence and understandable vertical framing
hypotheses.limitations: Deferred. Raw starts are not engagement and cross-format conversion may be unobservable.

hypotheses.title: Reduce production rework
hypotheses.hypothesis: Song lock and a finished-quality sample before full production reduce labor/cash per accepted song.
hypotheses.proposed_effect_rule: Set after three logged productions; no threshold yet
hypotheses.guardrails: Creative acceptance, audio and movement standards unchanged
hypotheses.limitations: Track all generation attempts and failures; no creative-quality acceptance inferred from a successful render.
